subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like tool failures with `includeDetails: true` be suppressed before mutating warning handling, including cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose paths, or should those detail-warning paths remain visible?
rationale: Current tests encode visible detail warnings for several exec-like includeDetails paths, while the linked issue asks for broad suppression, so an automated repair cannot safely choose the permanent message policy.

options.title: Clarify Policy Then Repair
options.body: Decide the intended exec-like detail-warning behavior, then move or preserve the suppression branch and update regression tests to match that decision.

options.title: Preserve Existing Detail Warnings
options.body: Keep cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose exec details visible and narrow or close this branch if the reported behavior is not the desired product policy.

options.title: Accept Suppress-All Semantics
options.body: Make exec-like suppression run before mutating handling and update all conflicting tests so detail-mode exec warnings are intentionally hidden.

recommendation.title: Clarify Policy Then Repair
recommendation.body: Decide the intended exec-like detail-warning behavior, then move or preserve the suppression branch and update regression tests to match that decision.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent commits in the mutation helper and payload warning area make this the strongest routing signal for the policy choice.
